stories.title: Letters Across the Distance
sentences: Aisha and Vikram met during their first year of college and became close friends instantly.
When Vikram moved abroad for higher studies, they promised to stay in touch no matter what.
Since video calls were often difficult because of the time difference, they began writing letters instead.
Every letter carried small details about their days, their dreams, and how much they missed each other.
Months turned into years, and their letters filled an entire wooden box Aisha kept by her bed.
When Vikram finally returned home, he brought all of Aisha's letters with him in his suitcase.
Sitting together on the same bench where they first met, they read the letters aloud and laughed.
They realized that distance had only made their bond stronger, not weaker.
A year later, they got married, with the box of letters displayed proudly at their wedding.

vocabulary.meaning: the amount of space between two places or people
vocabulary.example_sentence: The distance between the two cities is short.
They shared a strong bond of friendship.

vocabulary.meaning: put on show for others to see
vocabulary.example_sentence: Her paintings were displayed at the gallery.

stories.title: The Umbrella They Shared
sentences: It started raining suddenly while Meera was waiting for her bus after work.
She had forgotten her umbrella at home and stood helplessly under the small shelter.
A stranger named Dev, waiting nearby, offered to share his umbrella until her bus arrived.
They talked about their jobs and hobbies while waiting, and the ten minutes felt much shorter.
Before her bus came, Dev asked for her number so they could talk again sometime.
Over the next few weeks, they met for coffee whenever it rained, calling it their little tradition.
Years later, at their wedding, guests were surprised to see a big umbrella hanging above the stage.
Meera explained to everyone that the umbrella was where their story truly began.

vocabulary.meaning: a place giving protection from weather
vocabulary.example_sentence: They took shelter under the tree during the storm.
Sunday lunch with family is our tradition.

vocabulary.meaning: a person one does not know
vocabulary.example_sentence: A stranger helped her carry the bags.

quiz.question_text: Why was Meera standing under the shelter?
options: It was raining and she had no umbrella
She was waiting for a friend
quiz.correct_answer: It was raining and she had no umbrella

quiz.question_text: Dev and Meera never met again after that rainy day.

stories.title: The Recipe Card
sentences: Arjun had never been good at cooking, but he wanted to surprise his wife Kavita on her birthday.
He found her grandmother's old recipe card for a mango dessert tucked inside a kitchen drawer.
The handwriting was faded, so he had to guess a few of the measurements carefully.
After two failed attempts and a smoky kitchen, his third try finally looked right.
When Kavita came home, she found the table set with candles and the dessert waiting for her.
She took one bite and her eyes filled with tears, recognizing her grandmother's recipe instantly.
Arjun admitted it took three tries, and Kavita laughed, saying it tasted like love regardless.
That recipe card now hangs framed in their kitchen as a reminder of that special evening.

vocabulary.meaning: having lost color or clarity over time
vocabulary.example_sentence: The old photograph had faded with age.

vocabulary.meaning: amounts of ingredients needed in a recipe
vocabulary.example_sentence: Follow the exact measurements for the cake.
She smiled regardless of the mistake.

stories.title: Notes on the Fridge
sentences: Rohan and Simran both worked long shifts that rarely matched, so they barely saw each other on weekdays.
To stay connected, Rohan began leaving small sticky notes on the fridge every morning before work.
The notes were simple, sometimes just a joke, a reminder, or a small compliment about her day.
Simran started replying with her own notes, and soon the fridge was covered in colorful little messages.
Even during their busiest and most tiring weeks, the notes reminded them they were still a team.
One year, Simran saved every single note and turned them into a small handmade book.
She gave the book to Rohan on their anniversary, and he read it twice, smiling the whole time.
They still leave notes today, even though their schedules have finally started to match.

vocabulary.example_sentence: He gave her a compliment on her cooking.

vocabulary.meaning: made by hand rather than machine
vocabulary.example_sentence: She gave him a handmade card for his birthday.

stories.title: Dancing in the Kitchen
sentences: After a long and tiring week, Farah and Imran often felt too exhausted to go out anywhere.
One evening, Imran turned on an old song from their college days while cooking dinner together.
Without thinking twice, Farah grabbed his hand and they began dancing slowly in the small kitchen.
They laughed at how clumsy they had become since their college dance classes years ago.
The rice nearly overcooked because they were too busy spinning around the kitchen island.
From that night, dancing in the kitchen became their favorite way to end a stressful week.
Even on their toughest days, that one song could instantly bring smiles back to their faces.

vocabulary.example_sentence: She felt exhausted after the long journey.

vocabulary.meaning: lacking grace or skill in movement
vocabulary.example_sentence: He felt clumsy on the dance floor.
It had been a stressful week at work.
